data.name: Adhrit
data.gender_notes: Adhrit is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Adhrit means one who is fearless and unassailable. It is derived from the Sanskrit word adhritah, which means 'unassailable, invulnerable'. This name is often given to boys who are expected to be strong, brave, and courageous. The name Adhrit carries the meaning “Fearless, Unassailable” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Adhrit usually hope their child will grow to embody fearless, unassailable and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Adhrit is a spiritual name that signifies fearlessness and invulnerability. It is believed that those named Adhrit are protected by the gods and have the strength and courage to overcome any challenge or obstacle.
data.etymology: Adhrit belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Fearless, Unassailable.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Adhrit total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
